method: Borderline = exact MIC within +/-1 two-fold dilution of source CC (CRyPTIC 0.25, MGIT 1.0). E04 OOF metrics recomputed excluding borderline samples, side-by-side. Production keeps ALL rows.
interpretation: 454 borderline samples (191 resistant, 0.221 of all positives). Excluding them shifts AUC 0.9085->0.9045 (delta -0.0041). Label noise near the cutoff is modest; sensitivity analysis only.
caveats: SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS, not a model change; production keeps all rows. Censored MICs (<=,>) excluded from borderline. NICD MGIT MICs largely unavailable. Margin-weighted fit NOT promoted from this audit (pre-registered).
supports: Label-noise audit (P-E17): quantifies cutoff-adjacent uncertainty honestly.
